in_sanskrit.name: Nirnay
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: a firm or final decision or determination

in_marathi.name: Nirnay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirnay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nirnay is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'nir' meaning 'to decide' and 'nay' meaning 'decision'. It symbolizes the act of coming to a definite or firm conclusion. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to make decisions for the universe.
